<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will count the distinct signals that fall within the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (approximately 110–160 ppm). This will give the number of aromatic carbons.</thought>
